keyFindings.description: rawHTMLScan asks goldmark's raw HTML parser, which reads a declaration only after `<!` plus an uppercase letter and rejects control characters in an unquoted attribute value; CommonMark 0.31 and the editor's engine read both as raw HTML. Reproduced: `\<!x;a@b.cc>`, `Set \<!x;a@b.cc> now`, `Set \<!doctype x;a@b.cc> now` and `\<a b=\x01;a@b.cc>` are stored escaped at base af1ff09c (the engine reads text and a mailto: link) and stored raw at 3ff56757: the engine reads `Set ` + an html node (the link lost), and for `<!x;[a@b.cc](mailto:a@b.cc)>` and `<a b=\x01;…>` gives no document at all (MilkdownError: Cannot create node for doc).
The fragment names the autolink escape only; the raw-HTML escape (`Set \<input value=me@x.cc>` stored with `\<`) is not described.
